description: List every active subscription for a given wallet address. Each entry has the publisher address, topic, status, when you subscribed, messages received in 7/30 days, USDC spent in 7/30 days, and the timestamp of the last message received. Use this to see what you're currently paying for and decide whether to unsubscribe.

indexerUrl.description: Optional indexer URL override (default: INDEXER_URL/BYTE_INDEXER_URL env or https://feeds.payperbyte.io)

subscriber.description: Wallet address to list subscriptions for

name: byte_list_my_subscriptions

subscriptions.description: Active subscriptions for the given wallet

lastMessageAt.description: Unix timestamp of most recent message

spend30dUsdc.description: USDC spent in last 30 days (decimal string)

spend7dUsdc.description: USDC spent in last 7 days (decimal string)

status.description: Subscription status (string label or numeric code)
